name: Sour cherry
description: Sharp red cherries too tart to eat raw — stewed, dried or drunk as sharbat.

tcm.note: Sour and fluid-generating; cooler than the sweet cherry.

ayurveda.note: Shita and sour — a summer sharbat fruit.

unani.note: Thanda; albaloo sharbat is a standard Levantine and Persian cooler.

histamine.note: Sour stone fruit, and usually preserved in syrup or dried.

effects.note: Small trials and a 2025 systematic review link tart cherry with modest gains in sleep duration and efficiency, plausibly from a small melatonin content plus anti-inflammatory compounds rather than one mechanism alone. A possible effect, not a promise — response to it varies from person to person.
